items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: Buddy Petit had one downtown because they used to buck each other all the time.

ctx.x: That's just exactly what I'm saying. Now I'll give you another one. A lot of people think New Orleans had one style of music. No. You had different sounds. You had guys that played just as the music was written. You understand? Yes. You had musicians that played arrangements. Then you had small groups like Buddy Petit, Bunk Johnson playing something else. You see, like you have now, today. You have bands, we call them commercial bands now. You have the studio bands and the radio and TV. Wonderful musicians…
